digest.component_or_area: code-review trigger routing and overlay system
propositions: The committed high-precision trigger tier fires on 13.3% of rebar diffs; the noisy-tier vocabulary adds 22.0% more for 35.3% combined, with three traced corpus bugs triggering only through noisy-tier tokens.
Project-specific trigger vocabulary must be added to .rebar/criteria_routing.json as a concurrency overlay entry with token list and file glob patterns.

A diff containing index.lock (a project-specific token absent from committed routing) must fire the concurrency overlay when effective routing is read from repo context and must not fire under committed-only routing.
The two-layer trigger design (committed high-precision tier + project noisy tier) and its measured fire-rate tradeoff must be documented in docs/llm-framework.md with this repo as a worked example.
